1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Warisan Kebangsaan

(Perisytiharan Warisan Kebangsaan) (Objek Warisan) (No. 2) 2016.

Warisan Kebangsaan

2. Objek yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang telah diisytiharkan sebagai objek

warisan dalam Perisytiharan Objek Warisan (No. 2) 2015 [P.U. (B) 488/2015]

yang disiarkan dalam Warta pada 15 Disember 2015 dan disenaraikan dalam

Daftar diisytiharkan sebagai Warisan Kebangsaan.

Menteri Pelancongan dan Kebudayaan

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF NATIONAL HERITAGE)

(HERITAGE OBJECT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of

the National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of National

Heritage) (Heritage Object) (No. 2) Order 2016.

National Heritage

2. The objects specified in the Schedule that have been declared as heritage objects

in the Declaration of Heritage Object (No. 2) 2015 [P.U. (B) 488/2015] as published

in the Gazette on 15 December 2015 and listed in the Register are declared to be

National Heritage.

SCHEDULE

(1)

Objects

(2)

Location of objects displayed

1. The drawing of Pago-Pago,

Abdul Latiff Mohidin (1964)

National Visual Arts Gallery,

Kuala Lumpur

2. The drawing of Malaysian Scenery,

Khalil Ibrahim (1959)

National Visual Arts Gallery,

Kuala Lumpur

Made 11 April 2016

[JWN.PP.600/3/51/1/2; PN(PU2)652/Jld. 12]

DATO' SERI MOHAMED NAZRI BIN TAN SRI ABDUL AZIZ

Minister of Tourism and Culture
